notes: Fresh single-page analysis. visual-trees.json not produced by scrape; selectors resolved directly from cleaned.html DOM (one <header> + six <section> elements inside <main id="main-content">). page-templates.json 'home' template has 0 coverage gaps, so no gap pages analyzed.

sections.overview: Page hero: headline, subheading and two CTA buttons on the left; a stacked group of three lifestyle images on the right.

sequences.description: Large heading 'Fresh looks, bold stories, real life', subheading paragraph, and two call-to-action buttons ('See case', 'All stories') arranged as a left column beside a right column of three cover images.

sections.overview: Featured article intro laid out side-by-side: a large cover image on the left; breadcrumbs, heading, author name and date/read-time meta on the right.

sequences.description: Two-column layout. Left: large 3x2 cover image. Right: breadcrumb trail (Home > Case studies), heading 'Fresh looks, bold moves, real stories', author 'By Taylor Brooks', and 'June 12, 2024 - 4 min read' meta line.

sections.overview: 'Style in every snapshot' gallery: centered heading and lead paragraph above a 4-column grid of eight square lifestyle images.

sequences.description: Centered heading 'Style in every snapshot' with lead paragraph 'Peek the latest looks in action'.
Responsive grid of eight square (1x1) images, four per row on desktop, images only with no captions.

sections.overview: Testimonial tabs: a large active panel showing a person's photo, name, role and quote, with a 4-item tab bar of avatar+name+role buttons below to switch between four trendsetters.

sequences.description: Interactive tabbed testimonial component with four switchable panels (Alex Rivera, Taylor Kim, Jordan Ellis, Morgan Blake). Each panel shows a large photo, name, role and quote; the tab controls are avatar + name + role buttons.

sections.overview: 'Latest articles' section: centered heading and lead paragraph above a 4-column grid of article cards, each with an image, a category tag, a date and a title.

sequences.description: Centered heading 'Latest articles' with lead paragraph 'Fresh looks, bold moves'.
Grid of four article cards, each a link containing an image, a category tag (e.g. 'Casual Cool'), a short date (e.g. 'May 12'), and a heading (e.g. 'Tennis style, redefined').

sections.overview: FAQ section: heading and subheading intro, followed by a list of four expandable question/answer accordion items.

sequences.description: Heading 'Got questions? We've got answers.' with subheading 'Fashion FAQs, answered fast'.
Four expandable FAQ items (details/summary), each a question that toggles to reveal an answer paragraph.

sections.visualStyle: dark background (inverse-section) with full-bleed background image and dark overlay
sections.overview: Closing call-to-action banner: a full-width background image with a dark overlay, overlaid heading, subheading and a single CTA button.

sequences.description: Full-width banner with a background image and dark overlay. Overlaid content: heading 'Fresh looks, bold stories, real life', subheading paragraph about the latest case study, and a single 'See more' CTA button.

localBlocks: Note: per fresh-migration instruction, existing project block variants are NOT reused. Local blocks present in repo (accordion-faq, cards, cards-*, columns, columns-*, hero, hero-*, tabs-testimonial, story-hero, carousel-hero, embed-video, video-featured) are listed for reference only.
